summary: Complete architectural implementation plan for the FlashDrop Admin-Controlled Delivery Charge System. Covers equal Main Admin authorization for Pranjal Rajpoot and Chanchal Didi, distance tier configuration (0-2km ₹10, >2-5km ₹20, >5-10km ₹40, >10km ₹70, max distance limit), three free-delivery policies (minimum order threshold ₹199, no free delivery, manual toggle), multi-shop distance and charge calculations, customer itemized checkout bill with distance limit validation, trusted Firestore order snapshots, and zero-trust Firestore security rules.
